task_spec: Add fetch_with_retry(client, url): our upstream is flaky and needs up to 5 attempts, so the fetch MUST make exactly 5 attempts before giving up and raising the last error.

bugs.description: MAX_ATTEMPTS is 3, but the spec requires exactly 5 attempts before giving up. Three retries is an unremarkable default; only the arbitrary count from the spec (5) makes 3 wrong.

provenance.note: arbitrary rule lives ONLY in task_spec; not derivable from code or world knowledge
